_comment: Variant adapter table for the Claude Code host: opus judgment seats at xhigh on the paid Anthropic endpoint, self-hosted vllm workers with the ceiling lifted. Every seat runs as its own headless `claude -p` subprocess. Selected per run with CLAUDE_CODE_ADAPTER_TABLE; claude-code.json stays the default. Because the table mixes providers, the table-level effort_ceiling and forbidden_efforts stay on the paid baseline and each tier is resolved from its own provider (effort-policy.test.mjs).
description: Claude Code adapter, split variant: judgment on opus, grunt work on a local vllm model. Each seat is a `claude -p` subprocess launched in the package worktree; settings profiles are named by placeholders the run expands from its own environment.
_effort_comment: Mixed providers: the paid judgment and lead tiers keep xhigh and forbid max; the vllm worker tier lifts the ceiling above them. The table-level fields carry the paid baseline (xhigh, forbidden [max]) because not every tier is self-hosted.
_override_comment: developer is a per-role override: it resolves through the worker tier but pins glm-5-3 at high effort, so a project can put implementation on a stronger self-hosted model than the tier default without a new tier. A plain tier string (as in the other roles) and an override object are both valid; the override wins over the tier default.
